summary: The Novo Nordisk Foundation offers three-year postdoctoral fellowships that start with two years of research at the University of Oxford, followed by a final year at a Danish host institution. They are for early-career researchers in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology, working across disciplines. Each fellowship is funded up to DKK 3.6 million. The call opened 30 September 2026 and closes 29 January 2027 at 14:00 Copenhagen time.
highlights: PhD in natural or technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology, obtained within five years of the start date.
PhD students may apply if their supervisor confirms graduation before the start.
Requires a research collaboration with a University of Oxford group and a base in, or plan to return to, Denmark.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Novo Nordisk Foundation page before applying.
